description: The image displays two pie charts illustrating the distribution of different types of errors and correct responses in two distinct categories, as indicated by the legend at the top: "Atomic Skill Fail" (dark teal), "Correct" (medium teal), "Reason Error" (light teal), and "Question Misunderstood" (very light gray). The right pie chart presents a different distribution: a large medium teal segment labeled "55.0%" for "Correct," a light teal segment labeled "21.0%" for "Reason Error," a very light gray segment labeled "14.0%" for "Question Misunderstood," and a small dark teal segment labeled "10.0%" for "Atomic Skill Fail." The overall layout suggests a comparison between two scenarios or datasets, with the left chart emphasizing a high rate of atomic skill failure and the right chart showing a high rate of correct responses.
